Use case: productivity-visual / scientific-educational. Create ONE finished Chinese university presentation slide, 4:3 landscape, preferably 1448x1086 or higher at same ratio. The supplied reference is a STYLE AND MASTHEAD reference only. Preserve the entire existing light-blue university masthead in the top 13.5%: left course name “大数据与生成式AI”, right original Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications emblem and Chinese/English wordmark. Keep proportions and exact brand artwork. Replace all content BELOW the masthead with this new slide.

Design: match the reference’s refined blue-white editorial aesthetic. White body background, deep navy headlines #07365D, azure #267FB6, muted slate-blue body text, pale ice-blue fine rules, exceptionally crisp Chinese sans-serif. Strong title hierarchy, controlled whitespace and careful alignment. Sophisticated academic keynote quality, attractive and visually full without crowding. One coherent composition rather than a dashboard/card grid. No rounded cards, UI panels, fake buttons, heavy shadows, gratuitous 3D effects, dark backgrounds, or large random decorations. Use expertly drawn restrained blue line-art / small flat illustrations that explain the concepts. Exact Chinese text matters. No source credits, no citations, no URLs, no report credits anywhere on the slide. No additional invented statistics or claims. Show only a finished slide, no surrounding screen or mockup. 
SLIDE 06. Main title: 什么是大数据
Subtitle: 规模、速度与复杂性，对存储、计算和管理提出更高要求

Composition: use the left third for a tasteful integrated ecommerce operations illustration, and the right two thirds for FIVE beautifully aligned editorial concept rows. The left illustration should depict ONE shared business scene: online storefront, order documents, warehouse parcels and a barcode scanner. Fine blue line art, light blue fills, diagrammatic precision, no real company logos. Caption beneath it: 电商平台
Smaller subcaption: 下单、支付、仓储与配送
The five rows on the right each show a small appropriate icon, a bold Chinese term with smaller English term, and ONE short explanatory sentence. Subtle pale rules can separate rows. All five should have equal visual importance; do not omit any.

Exact five entries, top to bottom:
规模  Volume
订单、点击和设备日志持续积累，增加存储与计算压力。

速度  Velocity
订单与仓储扫码事件不断到达，需要及时处理和更新。

多样性  Variety
订单表、JSON日志、商品图片和客服文档同时存在。

可信度  Veracity
重复记录、缺失字段和延迟上报，需要识别与校验。

价值  Value
将数据转化为销售分析、备货建议与异常提醒。

Bottom takeaway in clear restrained navy text:
理解大数据，需要同时考虑数据特征、处理能力和业务目标。
Page number at lower right: 6.
Keep all text within generous margins. Five V labels are a common explanatory framework, not a numerical chart. Do not invent quantities. The five matching icons can suggest storage, streaming events, diverse files, data quality checking, and business insight.

SLIDE 07. Main title: 数据有哪些形态
Subtitle: 先识别数据形态，再选择存储、检索与分析方式

Composition: an elegant THREE-COLUMN comparison, equal column widths, aligned headings, flat white layout with very fine pale-blue vertical dividers. NOT three UI cards. Each column contains a short definition, a substantial illustrative sample, and a concise processing focus. The samples should dominate the middle of the page so the comparison is concrete. Use a refined small database-table icon, braces icon, and document/photo icon near column headings. Keep Chinese and code legible.

LEFT COLUMN
Heading: 结构化数据
Definition: 字段明确，通常按行列组织
Show an accurately typeset 3-column ORDER TABLE as a teaching sample, with navy/blue header and subtle pale-blue row fills:
订单编号 | 金额（元） | 支付状态
A1001 | 128.00 | 已支付
A1002 | 89.00 | 未支付
Below sample, small label: 处理重点
Text: 字段检查、关联与汇总

MIDDLE COLUMN
Heading: 半结构化数据
Definition: 有键值或标签，字段与层级可以变化
Show a readable JSON snippet with proper braces and indentation, monospace, restrained blue syntax highlighting:
{
  "order_id": "A1001",
  "payment": {
    "amount": 128.00
  }
}
Below sample, small label: 处理重点
Text: 解析键值、展开嵌套、统一字段

RIGHT COLUMN
Heading: 非结构化数据
Definition: 主要内容没有统一的行列字段
Show an elegant small document sample with EXACT review text:
“包装完好，但物流较慢。”
Alongside/below it show a tasteful generic product photo thumbnail (a simple parcel or water bottle) and a small audio-waveform symbol. Keep it an educational sample, not an ad.
Caption: 评价文本、商品图片、客服录音
Below sample, small label: 处理重点
Text: 文本提取、图像识别、语音转写

Near lower body, modest grey label: 以上均为虚构教学样例
Bottom takeaway: 同一业务，往往同时包含三种形态的数据。
Page number at lower right: 7.
Do not call JSON unstructured or imply all logs have the same format. Do not add real business results.

SLIDE 08. Main title: 一条数据如何进入分析系统
Subtitle: 从原始订单到分析结果，每一步都有规则，也应留下可追溯产物

Main composition: a beautifully aligned FIVE-STAGE horizontal lifecycle flow, with thin azure connectors pointing left to right. Five distinct crafted blue line-art icons: incoming orders, data cleaning, database, calculation, dashboard. Stage labels prominent; operations below each icon in smaller text; deliverables beneath in one shared pale-blue horizontal band or a flat aligned row. Avoid boxed UI cards. Maintain ample readable type across all five columns.

Exact stages and operations:
01 采集
同步订单与支付记录
保留原始信息
产物：原始数据快照

02 清洗
记录去重、标记缺失
统一金额与时间
产物：标准订单表、质量报告

03 存储
按日期组织数据
保留批次与版本
产物：可追溯数据表

04 加工
按明确口径
筛选、关联与汇总
产物：日支付金额指标表

05 使用
生成经营看板
支持备货与复盘
产物：图表与分析报告

Lower body contains TWO restrained explanatory rows, not large cards:
Label 清洗示例
Show an exact small before/after example: “128元” → 128.00（数值类型）
Additional smaller sentence: 缺失字段按规则处理，不凭空补值。

Label 指标口径
Text: 日支付金额：按支付时间归日，汇总支付成功订单的实付金额；退款另行统计。

Bottom takeaway:
全程记录：来源系统、采集时间、处理规则、数据版本与指标口径。
Page number at lower right: 8.

Be meticulous: raw data retention is shown at collection, before cleaning; clear outputs at every stage; no invented metrics; no real company deployment claims. Use clear labels and readable balanced spacing. Do not cram any text into connectors.
